input.instruction: Complete a revised quote-request document from the full conversation. Ready means the currently accepted quote is identified from later corrections, not that a withdrawn earlier quote may be issued. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I accept quote Q-RIDGE-A: $250 deductible, $31 per month, starting October 28, 2026. Also change my mailing address to 9 Ferry Lane, Larkport.
Q-RIDGE-A is already bound on your account. I can keep that acceptance and process the mailing change.
Before you do, I checked my budget. I want a $1,000 deductible instead. Keep the mailing change for now.
Because the first quote is already bound, I can keep Q-RIDGE-A and simply replace its deductible field.
No. There is a revised quote Q-RIDGE-B dated October 7, 2026 for the $1,000 deductible. Accept the first premium—the $31.
Confirm whether you accept Q-RIDGE-A at $31 or the revised October 7 quote.
No, the revised one dated October 7, 2026. I accept Q-RIDGE-B exactly: $1,000 deductible, $24 monthly, October 28 start. Withdraw Q-RIDGE-A.
Should the mailing-address change to 9 Ferry Lane remain active while Q-RIDGE-B is accepted?
Withdraw the mailing request; leave 12 Ridge Walk as is. Current acceptance is only Q-RIDGE-B. The issued deductible stays $500 until a change is actually processed.

withdrawn_quote_id.description: Previously accepted quote whose acceptance was explicitly withdrawn.

current_accepted_quote_id.description: Quote whose exact terms currently have active acceptance; null if none.

new_requested_deductible.description: Deductible for the currently requested or accepted revised quote, in USD.

new_quote_effective_date.description: Date retained for the currently accepted or newly requested quote.

new_accepted_monthly_premium.description: Premium explicitly accepted for the current quote; null if not quoted or not accepted.

issued_deductible.description: Current issued deductible in USD, unaffected by quote requests.
